text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High eviction rate observed in prefix cache shard eu-west-1-a. Eviction rate > 65% over 3m, KV read errors +8%. Auto-prefetch disabled and alerts routed to on-call. incident_id=INC-2026-3369754321

oncall-sre: I'm paged, connecting. Can someone confirm customer visible errors? @support-beth @darren_m

support-beth: A few customers on Dedicated seeing intermittent 500s on /v1/generate, small spike in reports via support queue. No major outage yet; correlating tickets now. @lila_p tracking.

darren_m: looks like a hotkey storm targeting prefix hot:tenant:123.* - eviction pressure causing stale cache reads -> correctness bypass necessary. Suggest: 1) reroute hotprefixes to read-through for correctness, 2) apply temporary quota carveout for tenant 123, 3) traffic-shape low tier.

oncall-sre: OK executing surgical changes. Applying read-through reroute and quota trim now. Will also bump telemetry on affected keys. Steps below.

```bash
# reroute hotprefix to read-through (correctness safe)
infractl route set --shard eu-west-1-a --prefix "hot:tenant:123" --target read-through
# set temporary tenant quota to limit KV churn
quotactl set --tenant 123 --kv_qps 50 --note "emergency carveout"
# apply traffic shaping for low-tier traffic
trafficctl shape --selector "tier:low AND region:eu-west-1" --egress 20\n```

ash_k: putting a 20% global shaping on low-tier for eu-west-1 to reduce blast radius. Also toggling verbose KV telemetry for keys matching hot:tenant:123.* so we can see per-prefix miss/evict rates.

incident-bot: PagerDuty auto-ack assigned to oncall-sre (30m). Log: INC-2026-3369754321.

lila_p: Drafting customer note now: "We detected increased errors and are routing your traffic to a correctness-safe path. You may see slightly higher latency while we stabilize. We're monitoring and will follow up in 15 minutes." Sending to affected contacts.

oncall-sre: Reroute completed, quotas set, shaping applied. Eviction rate dropping to 18% in last 2m. KV error rate down to +1%. Monitoring for 15m.

support-beth: Support queue shows no new 500s from priority customers. Only latency degradation reports. I'll hold communication cadence: update at +15 and +45.

darren_m: recommend keep KV-bypass (read-through) for 1h and keep quotas in place. If telemetry stable, we'll roll back shaping and carveouts gradually.

ops-pager: handing off active monitoring to next oncall @ash_k for 1h. I'll remain available for escalation. :handshake:

ash_k: ack, monitoring dashboards and logs. If eviction flares again, plan B is to temporarily disable prefetch on eu-west-1-a and perform a quick model-routing fallback to smaller seq-length variants. Will coordinate with eng-runtime if needed.

oncall-sre: thanks all — logging mitigation steps in incident timeline and updating runbook.
